effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] By trashing 1 [Chronicle] trait card from your hand, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and gain 1 memory.
[Your Turn] When one of your [Chronicle] trait Digimon attacks, by suspending this Tamer, you may use 1 [X Antibody] or 1 Option card with the [Chronicle] trait from your hand with the cost reduced by 1.
